# Joining data frames

## Joining data frames

```{r join-syntax}
#| eval: false
something_join(x, y)
```

<div style="font-size:0.85em;">


- `left_join()`: all rows from x
- `right_join()`: all rows from y
- `full_join()`: all rows from both x and y
- `semi_join()`: all rows from x where there are matching values in y, keeping just columns from x
- `inner_join()`: all rows from x where there are matching values in y, return all combination of multiple matches in the case of multiple matches
- `anti_join()`: return all rows from x where there are not matching values in y, never duplicate rows of x
- ...

</div>

## Dealing with the missing values

Just in case you're curious...

```{r msng-code}
#| eval: false
professions %>%
  left_join(dates) %>%
  left_join(works) %>%
  mutate(
    birth_year = case_when(
      name == "Ada Lovelace" ~ 1815,
      name == "Marie Curie" ~ 1867,
      TRUE ~ birth_year
    ),
    death_year = case_when(
      name == "Ada Lovelace" ~ 1852,
      name == "Marie Curie" ~ 1934,
      TRUE ~ death_year
    ),
    known_for = case_when(
      name == "Rosalind Franklin" ~ "X-ray diffraction images revealing DNA's double helix structure",
      TRUE ~ known_for
    )
  )
```

---

# Case study: Medical records

---

## Medical Records
  

<div style="font-size:0.8em;">

- Have:
  - Enrolled: officially enrolled in Duke MyChart
  - Survey: completed by those seen in hospital clinics over past year
- Want: Survey info for all officially enrolled in Duke MyChart


---

```{r load-data}
#| include: false
enrollment <- read_csv("../data/enrolled.csv")
survey <- read_csv("../data/survey.csv")
```

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="35%"}
```{r show-enrollment}
#| message: false
enrollment
```
:::

::: {.column width="65%"}
```{r show-survey}
#| message: false
survey
```
:::

:::

</div>

## Medical records

::: {.panel-tabset}

## In MyChart

```{r in-mychart}
enrollment %>% 
  left_join(survey, by = "name") %>% 
  select(name, clinic)
```

## Survey missing

```{r survey-missing}
enrollment %>% 
  anti_join(survey, by = "name")
```

## MyChart not activated

```{r mychart-not-activated}
survey %>% 
  anti_join(enrollment, by = "name")
```

:::
